verdict: Organic engagement is declining across all locations; paid channels are dark.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all inbound activity across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision came entirely from Google Business Profile — a combined 340 actions including 18 calls, 244 direction requests, and 78 web clicks, with zero spend running on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement is now falling at all three locations, most sharply at O'Hare Precision where profile activity dropped 95% week-over-week, pointing to a visibility or listing issue rather than a gradual demand shift. With paid channels fully inactive, there is no backup pipeline to absorb these organic losses. Work is underway to investigate and restore GBP listing health, and paid reactivation is being evaluated to establish a lead source that does not depend solely on organic visibility. Next period, the focus is stabilizing GBP performance and assessing whether a paid campaign relaunch is warranted.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement is collapsing at O'Hare Precision and declining at Forte Metals and Advance Grinding — with paid channels off, this is the only active lead source.
watch_item.fix: Listing health is being reviewed for suppression or visibility issues, and paid reactivation is being evaluated to reduce reliance on a single organic channel.
